description: The spec documents only 204/400/401/404 on EnableServiceResource, but the API answers 409 when the service is already enabled on the server. STACKIT's own Terraform provider (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/serverbackup/enable/resource.go, Create, read 2026-11-01) treats http.StatusConflict from this call as 'Server backup is already enabled for this server'. Its schedule/resource.go matches the same case on the message 'Tried to activate already active service'. `Conflict` is already in the module, from CreateBackup and RestoreBackup. No live probe.
